results_due: late January to February 2027, going by Q2 being reported on 26 Oct
reasoning: Management guides 35-45% FY27 growth on FY26's ₹904 Cr, which is ₹1,220-1,310 Cr; H1 was ₹639 Cr, so H2 needs ₹580-670 Cr. Asked about a ₹700 Cr H2 (against about ₹400 Cr last year), the MD said 'definitely more than that', so we assume about ₹350 Cr a quarter: base ₹350 Cr is +39% on Q3 FY26's ₹252 Cr and 10% below Q2's record ₹388 Cr.
Revenue is lumpy: Q1 was ₹251 Cr, Q2 ₹388 Cr. Q2 included production orders executed; defence recognition follows milestones, and the order book rose only from ₹1,704 Cr to ₹1,765 Cr.
Margin: Q2 operating margin was 29% (Screener's rows), Q1 21%, Q3 FY26 20%. Management says margins vary with the mix and are 'not an annuity', so we use 25% in the base, 20% low and 29% high.
Profit after tax has been 41-46% of operating profit in recent quarters (interest ₹10 Cr+ a quarter, 30% tax regime on standalone); we use 42%.
risks: The MIGM order or Pinaka orders slip, so fewer production invoices in Q3
Product mix with more development projects lowers the margin
Ideal Explosives losses or Premier acquisition costs enter consolidated profit
Large execution timing: one big delivery moves ₹50-100 Cr between quarters
caveat: Screener's operating profit differs slightly from the company's reported EBITDA. Our estimate is not management guidance and is never scored.
